category_rule: Categories are charge groupings only. No category encodes a protected characteristic or a proxy for one, and no demographic field is derived or inferred.
caveats: Arrest is not a finding of guilt. Every entry is a recommended charge at the time of booking; cases may be dropped, reduced, or dismissed, and this dataset contains no case outcomes.

The source log is not comprehensive. Verbatim from Cap City News: it omits juvenile offenders, suspects recommended for charges of a sexual nature, and anyone who bonded or bailed out before the information was released.
Names are as printed in the source article. Different people can share a name; do not assume two records with the same name are the same person, or that a person here is someone you know.
Coverage is uneven across years (missing weekly reports, not fewer arrests); do not compare years.
No demographic field is derived, inferred, or published; categories are charge groupings only.
Corrections: if a record is wrong or a case was dismissed, open an issue and it will be corrected or annotated.
policy: Arrest records published WITH names and ages, as compiled and published by Cap City News from Laramie County law-enforcement logs (owner decision 2026-11-27; supersedes the 2026-10-17 publish-without-names policy).
